subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: Members of the Rajya Sabha are elected by:

options.option_text: Elected members of State Legislative Assemblies, through proportional representation
Direct vote of the general public in each state
The President alone, without any electoral process
Members of the Lok Sabha only

explanation: Rajya Sabha members are elected indirectly by elected MLAs of each state's Legislative Assembly via the single transferable vote system; 12 members are separately nominated by the President for expertise in art/literature/science/social service.

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch3 — Indian Polity — Deep Practice 3
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: The 'Basic Structure Doctrine', which holds that Parliament cannot amend the Constitution in a way that destroys its fundamental framework, was established by the Supreme Court in which landmark case?

options.option_text: Golaknath case (1967) — which actually held Parliament couldn't amend Fundamental Rights at all

explanation: Kesavananda Bharati (1973) established the Basic Structure Doctrine, allowing amendments but not to the Constitution's fundamental framework. Golaknath (1967) had earlier taken the stricter view that Fundamental Rights couldn't be amended at all — later refined by Kesavananda Bharati.
